name: Puzzle Me
summary:
All the fun, none of the frustration! Unless YOU want it!

Early Access of the soon-to-be ultimate jigsaw puzzle experience is here! Designed from the ground up and taking advantage of the unique features and freedom of Virtual Reality - it is the most accessible and most intuitive way of solving jigsaw puzzles. Probably even beating the real thing!

With game modes ranging from Zen to Expert it can be the most relaxing experience, the most mind bending challenge and everything in between.
